# Getting help

- **Using the app:** see the [support page](https://algorythmos.com/pdf-algo-pro/support), or email
  [pdfalgopro@algorythmos.com](mailto:pdfalgopro@algorythmos.com) with the subject
  `PDF Algo Pro support`. In the app, **Settings → Help → Report a problem** starts that email and
  can attach an optional diagnostics summary (never your documents).
- **A security problem:** follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Don't open a public issue.
- **A bug or idea for this repository:** open an issue with the bug or feature template.

We aim to reply to support email within two business days.
